source_name: CRAN source packages — explicit Rd documentation mathematics

official_access.access_mode: Acquire src/contrib/PACKAGES plus current source package tarballs from CRAN or an official rsync mirror on an external executor. Prefer a synchronized mirror or bounded package batch over page-by-page package scraping. Source tarballs remain transient acquisition objects; the Atlas lake persists Parquet derivatives only.

scope.corpus: CRAN source packages and their man/*.Rd documentation files
structures: other explicit Rd \eqn and \deqn mathematical expressions
scope.original_representation: exact first verbatim Rd argument of \eqn{} or \deqn{}, with the complete source macro and optional ASCII alternative preserved separately
scope.batching: one deterministic inventory snapshot over the acquired PACKAGES index and selected current CRAN source tarballs
exclusions: Do not infer formulas from prose, R code, examples or function signatures in the extracted lane
Do not treat R formula-language expressions using ~ as mathematical equations unless a later reconstructed lane defines and tests that translation
Do not execute Rd macros, Sweave, R Markdown or package code during extraction
Do not OCR PDFs or rendered manuals when source Rd exists
Do not assert algebraic or functional equivalence at extracted stage

snapshot_policy.rule: Acquire the official src/contrib/PACKAGES snapshot and the selected current source tarballs outside GitHub Actions; SHA-256 the index and every tarball; build a deterministic sorted inventory by package/version/object path/size/hash; use cran-rd-math:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. A changed package set, version, index or byte sequence creates a new immutable snapshot and Internet Archive item. Never identify a snapshot only by wall-clock date.

license_policy.rule: CRAN requires a package-level License field and repositories may add License_is_FOSS and License_restricts_use metadata. Preserve the exact package/version/license metadata per occurrence. The adapter marks redistribution_allowed only when the acquired repository metadata explicitly says License_is_FOSS=yes and License_restricts_use=no; custom, missing, ambiguous or restrictive cases remain local/index-only until audited. Publication must preserve package-level license obligations and must not republish CRAN source tarballs as Atlas artifacts.

adapter.input: directory containing externally acquired CRAN source *.tar.gz objects plus the matching official src/contrib/PACKAGES snapshot
validation: only literal \eqn{} and \deqn{} macros in man/*.Rd are harvested; Rd comments are ignored
expression_original is the exact first verbatim Rd math argument; source_markup_original preserves the complete lexical macro and expression_ascii_original preserves the optional second argument
nested TeX braces are parsed without normalizing the expression
package, version, title, license, source tarball SHA-256, Rd path, Rd document SHA-256, topic, aliases, section and line range are retained
source_record_sha256 is independent of executor path and depends on immutable source identity and exact source bytes
no package code is executed and no OCR, prose reconstruction, symbolic equivalence or equation-family assertion occurs at extracted stage
